maps.points.west_dungeon_1.detail: You stand before a massive stone door. Eight circular sockets are carved into its surface, each clearly shaped for a key. There is no doubt: only by finding all eight of these strange keys will the path forward open.
maps.points.west_dungeon_1.detail-2: At (-4, -73) Stepped on by the party
maps.points.west_dungeon_1.dialogue: You stand before a massive stone door. Eight circular sockets are carved into its surface, each clearly shaped for a key. There is no doubt: only by finding all eight of these strange keys will the path forward open.
maps.points.west_dungeon_1.dialogue-3: One by one, you place the keys into their sockets. As the final one settles into place, the door begins to glow, stone grinding against stone. With a deep rumble, the way forward opens.
maps.points.west_dungeon_1.dialogue-4: Follow-up dialogue (without the required 8 blue key orbs)
maps.points.west_dungeon_1.dialogue-5: You are missing some keys. The ruins will not yield their secrets so easily.
